scope: Nineteen discrete metric socket-cap/internal-hex and external-hex machine-screw dimensional presets. Licensed BOLTS starting data are adapted against the identified primary dimensional/SKU sources. All twelve requested nominals have explicit family coverage statuses. Exact solids use authored envelopes and the shared nominal basic thread profile; omissions, engineering targets and source differences are explicit. No ISO 965 fit limits, current-standard compliance, physical/gage/strength certification, stock, material or grade claim. Manufacturer CAD, artwork and catalog prose are not redistributed.

entries.source_reference: HPC 2025, printed pages 554–557 / PDF pages 1–4: explicit CHC2-10/B L/B/DK/K/pitch. Socket limits: NBK ISO 4762:2004 / JIS B 1176:2015 excerpt, PDF page 1 (https://www.nbk1560.com/images/en-US/product/technical_data/rokkaku_bolt_NBK/rokkaku_bolt_NBK_1.pdf). Pinned BOLTS hexsocketheadcap supplies the licensed dimensional starting point.
modifications: Actual socket across flats is the midpoint of the NBK minimum/maximum range, an engineering target rather than a prescribed standard value or nominal key size.

The socket is a true hexagonal prism with a flat floor at the published minimum straight depth; socket-bottom tooling and mouth treatments are omitted. The remaining modeled floor k minus t exceeds the named NBK w minimum, without reproducing the source bottom shape.

Head height uses the named maximum; outer head diameter retains the explicit HPC DK envelope. Surface treatment is unspecified and surface detail is omitted; numerical agreement with a plain or knurled maximum does not establish a surface variant.
Explicit HPC SKU L/B values replace threshold inference. HPC full-thread equality rows M3x20, M4x25, M5x25, M6x30, M8x35 and M10x40 differ from the strict shorter-than BOLTS threshold convention.

Metric coarse threads use the shared nominal basic profile, not ISO 965 fit limits. Nominal-diameter shank, sharp thread transition, sharp tip and head envelopes omit runout, underhead fillets, chamfers and dimensional tolerances. Material, grade, coating and stock are unspecified.

entries.source_reference: Norelem 07171 PDF pages 1–2: discrete full-thread DIN 933 dimensional row; no dated standard edition identified for this product source. Separate dimensional cross-check: Nufast DIN 933:1987 drawing dated 2014-06-25 (https://www.nufast.co.uk/uploads/DIN_933.pdf); M4 is absent, so no tolerance limits are transferred.
modifications: The full-thread length and head dimensions follow the discrete Norelem row; no Cartesian stock matrix or material/grade variant is inferred.

The head is a sharp regular hexagonal prism at the source across flats; its ideal corner diameter is derived from that geometry. Source E remains a reference/minimum cross-check, not a second independently authored head size.

The DIN M10 across-flats value is 17 mm. BOLTS ISO M10 variants combine 16 mm across flats with DIN minimum E 18.90 mm, exceeding the ideal 16 mm hex corner diameter; those hybrid rows are rejected, not relabeled.

Shared metric coarse basic-profile thread extends the authored underhead length. BOLTS unthreaded h detail, underhead fillets, tip/head chamfers, thread runout and dimensional tolerances are omitted. Material, grade, coating and stock are unspecified.
